answer: Each identity anchors one rooftop solar panel, its serial number and copper thread wiring registered on-chain. Every epoch the inverter signs a fresh generation curve, and sunlight that wanders across the roof leaves a pigment-shifted spectral fingerprint unique to that panel's coating and tilt. Two identities sharing one panel report the same curve and collapse to a single vote, with stake slashed. A Sybil farm wanting 100 votes must buy, install and maintain 100 panels on 100 different roofs at roughly $200 each plus wiring and permits, while an honest user proves one panel once per epoch.
